part.text:
No blockers in `draw_iris_dialogue.lua`:

* Reproducible: `draw(i)` is pure/deterministic; `pairs()` only for color conversion.
* Palette keys: all `box`/`poly` keys exist in `colors`.
* Bounds: all boxes/polys within `0-55`; `y=56` only as exclusive `max_y`.
* Order: `names={Preocupada,Tranquilizadora,Séria,Convidativa}` + `draw(i)` + `(i-1)*56` matches worried/reassuring/serious/inviting.

Limits for more detail: same `224x56 PNG / 4x56x56`, opaque `RGB` only, preserve silhouette/expression deltas/eye-mouth clusters, keep palette/orphan-pixel discipline from 31-color audit.
